notes: This store was an Elevate dispensary and now trades as Key Cannabis Dispensary KC North (Key is Elevate's retail brand). Google, Yelp, Yellow Pages and the website use the Key name. Leafly still uses the address leafly.com/dispensary-info/elevate-kc-north (shown name Key Cannabis - KC North) with phone (816) 648-6402, and Weedmaps search results still show "Elevate Missouri - KC North" (weedmaps.com/dispensaries/elevate-mo-2), which now opens a general Kansas City list. The storefront photo still showing "Elevate" was reported by the client and not checked by us.

keycannabis.com has two KC North pages: /shop/kc-north-mo/ (menu, linked from Google, phone (816) 831-3871) and /kc-north/ (phone and click-to-call link (802) 831-3871, wrong area code; DataForSEO page test, Nov 12, 2026). Perplexity's search results also picked up the (802) number. The Google profile link carries a tracking tag (utm_source=terrayn_gbp).

Competitors were picked from the live Google map packs run from Gladstone, MO on Nov 12, 2026: NatureMed Dispensary at 2631 NE Vivion Rd (about 1.2 miles west; in 3 packs, its Gladstone sister store in 2 more), Kansas City Cannabis Company - Dispensary at 8170 NW Prairie View Rd (2 packs) and SWADE Dispensary North KC at 1041 Burlington St (1 pack). Other Key stores were excluded.

Kansas City Cannabis Company's Google name was "Kansas City Cannabis Co." in Sep 2026 listing data and "Kansas City Cannabis Company - Dispensary" in the Nov 12 map pack, so it is marked as not matching the real name. Its Google hours in Sep data were 10 AM to 9 PM, while Leafly, Weedmaps and the Nov 12 map pack show it closing at 10 PM.

Review counts for NatureMed (1,800) and SWADE (1,600) are the rounded figures Google showed in the Nov 12 map pack; Sep 2026 listing data showed 1,735 and 1,579. Key's 2,273 is exact (Google knowledge panel, Nov 12). Photo and profile detail counts come from DataForSEO listing data last updated Sep 2026.

Search volumes are Semrush US (phrase_these, Nov 2026). Local phrases use the town name; "dispensary open now" (3,600) is a nationwide figure because Google hides city-level volume for it. "kansas city cannabis" (2,900) was left out of vp_keywords because it is mostly people looking for the Kansas City Cannabis Co. brand.

Google results were run with location "Gladstone,Missouri,United States" (the SERP tool has no coordinate option); the store sits on the Kansas City / Gladstone line. An AI Overview appeared only for "best dispensary in kansas city", but its text did not load, so it is counted as not naming the store. The brand search showed an AI Overview built from the Google profile and keycannabis.com.

AI scan prompts: North Kansas City best dispensary, which dispensary in Kansas City, good dispensary in Gladstone, best dispensary in Kansas City, drive thru dispensary in Kansas City, dispensary open now in Gladstone, plus the brand question. Competitor mentions are counted at brand level (for example "NatureMed" or "Nature Med - Gladstone" counts for NatureMed). AI answers named other Key stores (KC East, KC South, Belton) in 4 answers instead of KC North.

Key domain numbers (rankings 4,042 / 888, homepage load 3.99 s, health 88.19, homepage alt text 4 of 19, 12 months of traffic) are the same keycannabis.com measurements taken Nov 12, 2026 for the Belton audit; backlinks (889 sites, 50% spam, 983 broken) were re-checked today and match. All four domains serve several stores, so domain numbers are not store-level.

Kansas City Cannabis Co.'s homepage blocked our page test (403 from Cloudflare), so its load time, health score and alt text are null. NatureMed's YouTube channel exists but we could not confirm a video count, so it is null.
Traffic months are Nov 2025 to Oct 2026 (DataForSEO estimated organic visits, United States).
PR counts come from one web search per brand. NatureMed's Pitch KC Best Dispensary wins (2025, 2026) are taken from NatureMed's own site and repeated by Perplexity; we did not open The Pitch's page.
Price: Headset publishes a US average basket ($47.03, 12 months to Sep 2026) but no Missouri basket, so the US figure is used, as in the Belton file.

Yelp shows the store as Key Cannabis Dispensary KC North with categories Cannabis Clinics, Vitamins & Supplements and Vape Shops; a Yelp review quoted in Google results says "They are now Swade dispensary" (SWADE took over the former BesaMe Wellness store at 1041 Burlington St, not this address).
